items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lennie Niehaus, yourself, Jimmy Giuffre, Shelly Manne on drums. Sounds like it could have been a real hip thing.

ctx.x: But when I look at the personnel on here. Lennie Niehaus, yourself, Jimmy Giuffre, Shelly Manne on drums. Sounds like it could have been a real hip thing. You‟re playing some pretty out music. Has he continued to have an influence on you at this time? Or you‟re basically just . . . .
No. No, I wasn‟t into twelve-tone or anything like that at that time.
